correctness.rationale: The graph is (2J+K)-weighted regular. For the minority-spin set S of size k<=n, E_ex=2nJ+nK-2(2J+K)k+4J e_leg(S)+4K e_rung(S). Even n admits independent sets of all sizes <=n; odd n admits such sets through n-1, while any n-set has at least one internal leg edge by odd-cycle independence and a construction attains exactly one leg edge with zero rung edges. Field minimization is then a comparison of affine lines in k and the one exceptional sector. At saturation all independent sets occur, counted by the 3-state rung transfer matrix. The one-frustrated-bond positional average gives C_n(r)=(-1)^r(1-2r/n), and the same-rung correction counts the exceptional rung. Fresh independent exhaustive small-graph energies, minima, multiplicities and correlations for n=3..7 and J,K=(1,1),(1,3),(2,1) all matched. Infinite-n claim rests on structural argument.
